jobs.title: Strategy & Operations Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT ARQ

ARQ is one of the fastest-growing fintechs in the world. Our mission is to redefine how people interact with money across borders, building the backbone to move value seamlessly. We’re still early in our journey, which means every person who joins shapes the future of our product, culture, and growth. If you’re excited by big challenges, global impact, and the chance to grow fast with a world-class team, ARQ is the place to do it.

 


THE ROLE

Licensing is mission-critical at ARQ. As we expand across banking, wealth management, payments, and crypto, in multiple jurisdictions simultaneously, the ability to secure and maintain the right licenses determines whether we can operate, grow, and serve our customers at all. 

You will own the global licensing workstream end to end. You will track every active and upcoming license application across all jurisdictions, drive deliverables across product, legal, operations, and finance, and make sure ARQ has the regulatory permissions it needs to operate and scale its business. You will work directly with senior leadership and external counsel, and you will be expected to bring structure, rigour, and pace to one of the most consequential workstreams in the company.

This role sits at the intersection of regulatory strategy, product, operations, legal, and finance. If you thrive in complex, high-stakes environments and want early ownership at a world-class fintech, this is for you.

 


WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

You will drive the global licensing agenda across all licenses and jurisdictions, ensuring ARQ has the permissions it needs to operate and grow, and that nothing falls through the cracks.




OWN THE GLOBAL LICENSING PIPELINE

 - Maintain a single source of truth for all active and upcoming license expansions globally, covering banking, payments, wealth, and crypto across multiple jurisdictions

 - Track every milestone, deadline, and dependency in each licensing process, surfacing risks early and driving resolution across teams

 - Build and manage a structured project plan for each licensing workstream, ensuring accountability across product, legal, finance, and operations stakeholders

 - Coordinate with external counsel and local advisors in each jurisdiction, managing deliverable quality, timeline, and cost


DRIVE CROSS-FUNCTIONAL EXECUTION

 - Translate regulatory requirements into actionable workstreams for product, engineering, operations, finance, and legal teams, owning follow-through on each

 - Draft and structure submissions, policy documents, regulatory responses, and internal materials with rigour and precision

 - Coordinate preparation for regulatory submissions, implementation tables, and go-live audits, ensuring each team is ready and all materials are of the highest standard

 - Act as the connective tissue between global teams and in-market General Managers or licensing leads, ensuring alignment and removing blockers


BUILD THE LICENSING FUNCTION

 - Design and continuously improve ARQ’s internal systems, templates, and playbooks for managing licensing processes at scale across multiple jurisdictions

 - Develop frameworks for evaluating new license requirements as ARQ enters new markets or launches new products

 - Monitor regulatory developments across key jurisdictions, identifying licensing implications early and advising leadership proactively

 - Support the maintenance and renewal of existing licenses, ensuring ongoing compliance with license conditions and regulatory expectations

 


WHAT YOU’LL NEED

 - 3–6 years of experience in a high-performance environment: MBB management consulting, or an early leadership role at a high-growth startup

 - Exceptional structured problem-solving and analytical skills: you break complex, ambiguous situations into clear plans and drive them to completion

 - Outstanding written and verbal communication; you can synthesise complexity into precise, compelling documents and presentations for senior audiences

 - Proven project management and organisational ability: you run multiple high-stakes workstreams in parallel without dropping details

 - Strong learning velocity and intellectual curiosity; you pick up new domains quickly and operate confidently across legal, regulatory, financial, and technical subject matter

 - High ownership mentality with a bias for action: you don’t wait to be told what to do and you hold yourself and others accountable for outcomes

 - Comfort operating in fast-moving, early-stage environments with limited structure and high ambiguity

 


NICE-TO-HAVES

 - Exposure to financial services, fintech, or regulatory environments, whether through consulting engagements, direct roles, or coursework

 - Experience working across multiple jurisdictions or geographies simultaneously

jobs.title: Financial Controller &  Regulatory Reporting Officer – Gibraltar
jobs.description:
ABOUT ARQ

ARQ is one of the fastest-growing fintechs in the world. Our mission is to redefine how people interact with money across borders, building the infrastructure to move value seamlessly. We’re still early in our journey, which means every person who joins shapes the future of our product, culture, and growth. If you’re excited by big challenges, global impact, and the chance to grow fast with a world-class team, ARQ is the place to do it.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Financial Controller & Regulatory Reporting Officer to join our Gibraltar office. This is a hands-on role with broad ownership: you will be the primary finance lead for GIB's P&L, balance sheet and regulatory reporting under DLT license to the FSC, and will additionally oversee the financial operations of ARQ UK, a cost centre within the group together with ownership of the  reconciliation process of ARQ Globals financial and ledger accounts.

Reporting directly to the Group Controller, you will act as the financial backbone of two entities, ensuring integrity in reporting, compliance with local requirements, and tight control over costs. This role is ideal for a finance professional who thrives in a lean, high-ownership environment and is comfortable working across jurisdictions.




WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING 

Financial Control & Reporting: 

 - Own the month-end close process for GIB, ensuring timely and accurate financial statements in accordance with applicable accounting standards (IFRS).

 - Review and maintain the P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statements on a monthly basis.

 - Maintain a robust chart of accounts and ensure proper classification of all transactions.

 - Manage intercompany transactions and reconciliations between GIB and other group entities in line with our Transfer Pricing Policy.

 - Support the preparation of statutory accounts and liaise with external auditors.

 - Ensure compliance with local regulatory reporting requirements for the Gibraltar Company.

Cost Centre Oversight:

 - Oversee the financial operations of ARQ UK as a cost centre, including monthly cost review and variance analysis.

 - Ensure all ARQ UK costs are correctly allocated, accrued, and reported in line with group policies.

 - Monitor budgets versus actuals for ARQ UK and escalate material variances to the Group Financial Controller.

 - Coordinate with local stakeholders in the UK to gather financial data and validate reporting accuracy.

Budgeting & Forecasting:

 - Contribute to the annual budgeting process for GIB and ARQ UK, working closely with the Group Financial Controller.

 - Prepare rolling forecasts and provide commentary on financial performance drivers.

 - Develop financial models to support business decisions and scenario planning.

Controls & Compliance:

 - Design, implement, and maintain robust internal controls for both GIB and ARQ UK.

 - Ensure adherence to group accounting policies and flag any deviations or exceptions.

 - Serve as the primary point of contact with the outsourced accounting provider, coordinating and reviewing the preparation and delivery of financial statements and periodic financial reports for GIB and ARQ UK.

 - Ensure the accurate calculation, provisioning, and timely payment of all applicable taxes for both entities, working in close collaboration with external tax advisors.

 - Monitor and ensure full compliance with the regulatory requirements of Gibraltar and the United Kingdom, keeping abreast of changes in local legislation and promptly escalating any compliance risks to the Group Controller.


WHAT YOU'LL NEED

 - Professional accounting qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA, or equivalent).

 - 5+ years of relevant experience in financial control, accounting, or audit roles.

 - Proven track record of owning month-end close and preparing statutory-quality financial statements.

 - Experience working in or with regulated financial services entities.

 - Strong knowledge of IFRS or UK GAAP.

 - Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail.

 - Advanced proficiency in spreadsheet tools (Excel or Google Sheets); comfortable with complex financial models and SQL

 - Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a lean team environment.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with multi-entity or multi-jurisdiction accounting environments.

 - Experience with Gibraltar and/or UK regulatory reporting frameworks.

 - Experience with ERP systems (e.g. NetSuite, SAP, or similar).

jobs.title: Growth Analytics Lead
jobs.description:
ABOUT ARQ

ARQ is one of the fastest-growing fintechs in the world. Our mission is to redefine how people interact with money across borders, building the infrastructure to move value seamlessly. We’re still early in our journey, which means every person who joins shapes the future of our product, culture, and growth. If you’re excited by big challenges, global impact, and the chance to grow fast with a world-class team, ARQ is the place to do it.




WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for a highly analytical and strategic Growth Analytics Manager to join our Growth team. This is a critical, high-impact role where you will be the owner of our growth data, budget, and financial planning, across our 4 core markets..

You will transform raw data into actionable strategies, working hand to hand with the Head of Growth and founders to accelerate business performance. If you are passionate about blending complex data analysis with a deep understanding of consumer behavior, we want to hear from you.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Serve as the analytical backbone for the Growth leadership team, presenting findings and strategic recommendations that directly influence budgeting, roadmap prioritization, and business strategy.

 - Define, monitor, and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) across the entire user journey (AARRR: Acquisition, Activation, Retention, Referral, Revenue).

 - Conduct complex, rigorous analyses (e.g., cohort analysis, A/B test analysis, attribution modeling, lifetime value (LTV) forecasting) to identify opportunities for growth optimization and understand 'why' user behavior changes.

 - Design, implement, and analyze controlled experiments, providing clear, statistically significant recommendations to product and marketing teams.




WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED

 - 4+ years of professional experience in an analytical role

 - Background in McKinsey, BCG or Bain is preferred.

 - Expert proficiency in SQL for data querying, transformation, and analysis.

 - Advanced experience with a modern data visualization tool (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Power BI).

 - Proven ability to work with statistical tools or languages for data analysis (e.g., Python/R is a strong plus).

 - Deep understanding of statistical significance and the proper execution/analysis of A/B/n testing.

 - Strong understanding of key digital marketing metrics (CAC, ROAS, CPA, etc.) and how marketing investment impacts the P&L.




BENEFITS

 - Competitive salary and benefits 

 - Stock options, so you own part of what you build

 - Discretionary performance bonus

 - The latest tools and technology

 - A world-class team that will challenge and grow your skills

 - The opportunity to help build the best fintech app in Latin America

 - Office Policy: 3-4 days a week in-office

jobs.title: Growth Manager Brazil
jobs.description:
ABOUT ARQ

ARQ is one of the fastest-growing fintechs in the world. Our mission is to redefine how people interact with money across borders, building the infrastructure to move value seamlessly. We’re still early in our journey, which means every person who joins shapes the future of our product, culture, and growth. If you’re excited by big challenges, global impact, and the chance to grow fast with a world-class team, ARQ is the place to do it.




WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

We’re hiring a Growth Manager to own and scale ARQ's performance-based partnerships channel in Brazil. This role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution: you’ll identify and prioritize partnership opportunities, test their economics, prospect, negotiate and launch deals, and scale the channels that perform.

This is an opportunity for a strategic business developer or a top-performing consultant ready to launch a channel from scratch and take ownership from day one.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Develop the channel strategy: Map the Brazilian market, identify promising partner segments, assess their potential, and determine where ARQ should focus.

 - Build and test commercial theses: Develop business cases, partnership structures, unit economics, and pilot plans for new acquisition channels.

 - Originate and close partnerships: Build a pipeline, approach decision-makers, negotiate CPA and revenue-share agreements, and close deals.

 - Launch and scale: Coordinate partner onboarding, remove launch blockers, and get new partners generating activated users quickly.

 - Optimize performance: Analyze conversion, CAC, volume and contribution by partner; stop weak experiments and scale the strongest ones.

 - Own the partner lifecycle: Maintain senior relationships, solve operational problems, manage incentives and continue expanding productive partnerships.

 - Execute cross-functionally: Work with Product, Legal, Finance and Operations to launch partnerships quickly and compliantly.




WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED

 1. High motivation, bias to action and goal orientation: You’re energized by ambitious targets and comfortable being measured on the volume you close and activate.

 2. Agency and problem-solving: You independently identify opportunities, remove obstacles and turn ideas into results.

 3. Comfort with ambiguity and full ownership: You can create structure where none exists, set priorities and move forward without waiting for a detailed playbook.

 4. Strong analytical and commercial judgment: You can evaluate opportunities, understand partner economics and use data to decide what to test, stop or scale.

 5. Relevant experience through one of two paths:

 - Experience in business development or affiliate programs, at a high-growth startup; or

 - A strong strategy-consulting background with the motivation to transition into a hands-on business development role and own outcomes end to end.

 6. Fluency in Portuguese and English.



It will be a strong advantage if you have experience in fintech or an existing network within Brazil’s financial-services or creator economy.






BENEFITS

 - Competitive salary and benefits 

 - Stock options, so you own part of what you build

 - Discretionary performance bonus

 - The latest tools and technology

 - A world-class team that will challenge and grow your skills

 - The opportunity to help build the best fintech app in Latin America

 - Office Policy: 3 days a week in-office in SP, Brazil.
